name: Tokazuya Hiyori
source: Hiyori is a 5th grader in the 22nd Century school rape practice class. As a measure against the declining birthrate, a rape training project was adopted by the school. So Hiyori is raped in front of her class by her teacher 33 year old Touda Seigo.
